newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yaohan HK privatisation plan withdrawn.
newsitem.headline: Yaohan HK privatisation plan withdrawn.

text.p: Yaohan International Holdings Ltd has decided to withdraw the proposal to privatise Yaohan Hongkong Corp Ltd (YHK), the companies said in a joint statement on Thursday.

The decision came after Yaohan International recived a letter from a YHK shareholder holding 57.87 million YHK shares or 16.1 percent of the company, saying it had decided not to accept the offer to privatise YHK, the statement said.

"It is not possible for the proposal to be approved by holders of at least 90 percent in value of the scheme shares at the court meeting requisite for the fulfilment of the conditions of the proposal," it said.
It did not identify the shareholder.
Last month, Yaohan International raised the share exchange ratio in its plan to privatise YHK to 505 new Yaohan International shares, from 451 shares, for every 1,000 YHK shares held.
Yaohan International shares fell one cent to HK$0.78 at midday on Thursday, while YHK shares were unchanged at HK$0.32.
